confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Aix-en-Provence pricing; no live booking pages or menus were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is least certain because the Festival d'Aix in July can push hotel rates up. Drink anchors use typical French terrace pricing. The FX observation comes from an rba.gov.au search snippet; the page itself was not opened to confirm it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Provençal cities with similar tourism, such as Avignon, Montpellier and Nîmes, adjusted upward for Aix's central-Provence tourist demand in July and its festival season.
